pl-l4d36c3-d1e115.summary: States that if a woman married a free man and he, to provide a cause for divorce, made himself someone's slave, he cannot dismiss his wife, nor can she be reduced to servitude because of the marriage bond.

pl-l4d36c3-d1e121.summary: Cites the synod: a free man who married a free woman and after having children made himself a slave as an occasion for divorce; it was judged that he must not dismiss his wife, nor is she to be reduced to servitude under Christ's law, since he became a slave without her consent.
claims: The wife remains free and married.

pl-l4d36c3.summary: If a man who married as a free man later makes himself someone's slave to provide a cause for divorce, he cannot dismiss his wife, nor can she be reduced to servitude because of the marriage bond, as a synod ruled.
claims: The wife is not made a slave by her husband's self-enslavement.
